_comment: The OMP/Pi pij_send body for a reply (rust-runtime.ts send: in_reply_to set from the last inbound message). The TS half (rust-runtime.test.ts) asserts the adapter sends exactly these keys, populated; the Rust half (directory_http.rs) posts this body to /v1/send, where the reply gate accepts it pane-bound and refuses it without caller (review of #152, S152-001). Values fit the Rust rig: %51 is pij-holder's pane and req-limit its request.
